# The usefulness of matrix equations again


::: {#exr-matrix-solve-1}
> Solve the system of equations
> $$
> \begin{aligned}
> x + y + z &= 6 \\
> 2x - y + z &= 3 \\
> x + 2y - z &= 4
> \end{aligned}
> $$
> by converting to an augmented matrix and row reducing.
:::

::: {#exr-matrix-solve-2}
> Solve the system of equations
> $$
> \begin{aligned}
> x + y + z &= 3 \\
> 2x + 2y + 2z &= 6 \\
> x - y &= 1
> \end{aligned}
> $$
> by converting to an augmented matrix and row reducing.
:::
